description: Send previewed orders to your Alpaca paper account with their confirmation token (the kill switch is read again first), or cancel open paper orders by id. Every send is logged, hash-chained.

cancel_order_ids.description: Open paper order ids to cancel instead (no token needed).

token.description: Confirmation token from preview_paper_orders or rebalance_to_weights.
